verdict.rationale: Polar's docs page on testing webhooks locally shows a first-party `polar listen http://localhost:3000/` command, which indicates an official CLI exists. The only evidenced use is forwarding webhooks to localhost, so how much of the platform the CLI covers is unproven. Missing for 10: install and reference documentation for the CLI, commands for managing products, customers, subscriptions and orders, scriptable or agent-friendly output modes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
